Charming cottage near Hellishólar in Fljótshlíð.
This spacious and modern home is tastefully designed with a touch of luxury and offers everything you need for a memorable stay.
The house features a fully equipped kitchen, a generous living area with stunning views of Eyjafjallajökull, cozy bedrooms, a quality bathroom, and a relaxing hot tub.
It’s an ideal base for exploring South Iceland including the Golden Circle, Seljalandsfoss, Þórsmörk, and many more unforgettable destinations.

The space
The cabin is spacious and cozy, featuring four bedrooms, a comfortable living room, and a well-equipped kitchen. It's perfect for families or groups of friends looking to spend quality time together. The house offers stunning views of the famous Eyjafjallajökull glacier, creating a peaceful and scenic atmosphere. Outside, you'll find a private hot tub — ideal for relaxing after a day of exploring Icelandic nature. This is a wonderful place to unwind and experience the beauty of Iceland in comfort.

Guest access
Guests have full access to the entire house, including all indoor spaces and the private hot tub outside. Please note that the garage and sauna on the property are not available for guest use, as they are reserved for private use. We appreciate your understanding and hope you enjoy the rest of the facilities to the fullest.

Other things to note
Hot Water
Please note that the cabin has a limited supply of hot water, as it is heated using an electric water heater. This means that after extended use — such as multiple showers in a row — the hot water may temporarily run out and need some time to reheat. We kindly ask guests to keep this in mind during their stay. Thank you for your understanding!

This is not a private single home. Very clean and modern. Light switches were confusing and lights are dim. The host is great. Communicated right away when asked a question. We had to leave after one night because there was an overwhelming smell in the entire place. If you have chemical sensitivities DO NOT stay here. Broke out in hives and got a migraine. This was way too expensive for having a very miserable one night stay as we could not be refunded. Vioir was responsive when I told him about our experience.

There is also a restaurant there which is convenient and had decent burgers if you to walk there.
